title: True Sovereign Form
summary: Revealing his True Sovereign Form, Ha-Jun stands as the supreme protector of creation. Tae-Jun and Kuro gaze upon the culmination of their five-thousand-year covenant.

panels.shot: the true sovereign ha-jun standing on the starlight bridge wide hero shot
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands in breathtaking majesty: white jade horns, starlight hair flowing, six rainbow wings fanned wide.

panels.shot: tae-jun staring with his jaw slack, eyes full of reverent tears
panels.action: Tae-Jun lowers his sword, tears rolling down his cheeks in stunned, joyous awe: 'Ha-Jun... You look... incredible.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Tum sach mein ek devta lag rahe ho, Ha-Jun.

panels.shot: kuro mantle on ha-jun shoulders ruffling happily
panels.action: The starlight feather mantle ruffles warmly: 'I told you he had good bones. Five thousand years of searching, and I found perfection.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Our journey has reached its peak.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling gently his voice soft, melodic, and resonant
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles with the exact same boyish warmth: 'I'm still your little brother, Tae-Jun. I just have cooler clothes now.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main abhi bhi wahi Ha-Jun hoon jo math exam se darta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun laughing through his tears stepping forward
panels.action: Tae-Jun laughs out loud, stepping forward: 'Horns and wings won't save you from taking out the apartment trash, you know.'

panels.shot: ha-jun laughing catching tae-jun in a warm, gentle hug
panels.action: Ha-Jun wraps his wings and arms around Tae-Jun, holding his brother with soft, perfect warmth.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: I'll take out the trash, Hyung. Gladly.

panels.shot: the maiden of the tree of origin stepping forward with hands clasped
panels.action: The cosmic maiden bows deeply: 'The universal seam is sealed. But one final remnant of the past remains.'

dialogue.speaker: tree_maiden
dialogue.text: The soul echo of the First Demon Sovereign still lingers in the Mirror of Origins.

panels.shot: ha-jun turning his gaze toward the mirror of origins
panels.action: Ahead on the starlight sea floats a titanic crystal mirror reflecting the ancient dawn of creation.

panels.shot: inside the mirror: the ancient spirit of asmodaius waiting peacefully
panels.action: Inside the reflection stands the original Asmodaius, waiting with a solemn, expectant gaze.

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Come, Ha-Jun Kang. Let us exchange the final word.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping into the glass surface of the mirror without hesitation
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward, his boots rippling the reflective glass surface like water as he enters the mirror plane.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing before the living memory of first sovereign asmodaius
panels.action: The two Demon Sovereigns stand face to face: the First Sovereign of War and the True Sovereign of Peace.

panels.shot: asmodaius looking at ha-jun six wings of dawn with deep reverence
panels.action: Asmodaius inspects Ha-Jun's wings and eyes: 'Wings of creation, not destruction. You surpassed my wildest dream.'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Maine hamesha socha power sirf talwar se aati hai. I was wrong.

panels.shot: ha-jun extending his right hand open in a gesture of peace
panels.action: Ha-Jun offers an open palm: 'Power is only meaningful when used to protect the people you love.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Taqat ka matlab kisi ko jhukana nahi... Kisi ko uthana hota hai.

panels.shot: asmodaius grasping ha-jun hand: a flash of golden generational resonance
panels.action: The ancient progenitor takes Ha-Jun's hand; five thousand years of demon suffering dissolves into peace.

panels.shot: asmodaius smiling with peaceful tears: 'the demon race is free at last'
panels.action: Asmodaius whispers through tears: 'Thank you, my son. Our bloodline is redeemed.'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: Thank you, Ha-Jun. My soul is at rest.

panels.shot: asmodaius body dissolving into golden starlight particles
panels.action: The First Sovereign peacefully dissolves into golden stardust, blowing gently across the cosmic winds.

panels.shot: the mirror of origins transforming into a clear window showing earth
panels.action: The crystal mirror turns into a transparent window looking down at the sunlit continents of Earth.

panels.shot: earth below glowing with a permanent protective golden auroral shield
panels.action: Surrounding the blue planet is a shimmering, invisible auroral web of Sovereign Mana, warding off all future cosmic threats.

dialogue.text: An eternal aegis: no void shall ever threaten this cradle again.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping back out of the mirror beside tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps out onto the crystal root beside Tae-Jun, his heart completely light and unburdened.

panels.shot: tae-jun looking at ha-jun: 'is it done?'
panels.action: Tae-Jun asks softly: 'Is it finished?'

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling radiant and bright: 'it is finished.'
panels.action: Ha-Jun nods with radiant joy: 'It is finished, Hyung. Let's go home.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Poori tarah se. Let's go back to Seoul.

panels.shot: ha-jun gently folding his six massive wings behind his back
panels.action: Ha-Jun folds his magnificent starlight wings; they retract smoothly into his back, resting invisibly beneath his coat.

panels.shot: his horns retracting into subtle golden crest marks on his brow
panels.action: His white jade horns retract, leaving only a subtle, elegant golden sovereign mark between his eyebrows.

panels.shot: kuro mantle shifting back into the cute obsidian raven perched on his shoulder
panels.action: The starlight mantle condenses back into little Kuro sitting comfortably on Ha-Jun's shoulder, ruffling black feathers.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Ah, much better. Now, about that leftover fried chicken...

panels.shot: the brothers and kuro stepping toward the descending starlight portal
panels.action: The trio steps into the downward golden portal, leaving the Tree of Origin in timeless serenity.

panels.shot: the golden beam carrying them through the upper atmosphere toward seoul
panels.action: They glide through the warm autumn clouds, descending toward the familiar rooftops of Mapo district.

panels.shot: saint mirren university rooftop coming into view under the morning sun
panels.action: The university terrace glistens in clean morning sunlight, the picnic table still standing with cups and food.

panels.shot: min-jae and captain baek still waiting on the rooftop look up with gasps
panels.action: Min-Jae and Baek, still standing by the balustrade, look up and point in ecstatic joy: 'THEY ARE BACK!!'

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun landing lightly on the concrete terrace floor
panels.action: The brothers touch down gently on the terrace, their sneakers clicking softly on the clean concrete.

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling at min-jae holding up an empty cup cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun grins at Min-Jae: 'Hey. Any soda left?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Thoda soda bacha hai kya, Min-Jae?
